title: A doubly linked list
description:
Write a doubly linked list with a sentinel node.

```
push_back 1 2 3, push_front 0 -> 0 1 2 3
backwards: 3 2 1 0
erase 2 -> 0 1 3
size 3, no leaks
```
hints: Inserting `n` before `at`: `n->prev = at->prev; n->next = at; at->prev->next = n; at->prev = n;` (lesson 3.04).
`pushBack` is "insert before the sentinel" and `pushFront` is "insert before the sentinel's next".
requirements: A sentinel node whose `next` is the first node and `prev` the last, so empty lists need no special cases.
The destructor frees everything; copying is deleted.
stretch: Add an iterator class so `for (int x : list)` works.
